name: Kenya
prevalence_note: Kenya 2025-2026 warnings: east Africa Fake Mobile Money Credit & Reversal Scam; false Medical Emergency & Acquaintance Impersonation Scam.
cross_border_note: Calls in Swahili, Amharic, French or English, often from local mobile numbers.

scams.name: Utapeli wa kutuma pesa kimakosa na kuomba urudishe (East Africa Mobile Money)
scams.name_en: East Africa Fake Mobile Money Credit & Reversal Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: ile fedha tuma kwenye namba hii

scams.signals_en: Scammers send a forged confirmation SMS from an ordinary mobile number or push a reversible transfer, then call in panic claiming they sent hospital or school money to the wrong recipient.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate accidental mobile money transfers in Kenya and Tanzania are reversed exclusively through the mobile operator's official reversal short code or customer care line, never by initiating a fresh manual transfer to a stranger's number or entering a.
bait_tactics: Subiri kidogo, menyu ya huduma ya simu inakata kila nikijaribu kuangalia salio kwa sababu mtandao uko chini.
Sijapata ujumbe wowote mpya kwenye laini hii, ngoja nitafute miwani yangu ya kusomea chumbani.
Simu yangu ndogo yenye laini ya malipo imeishiwa chaji kabisa, subiri niweke kwenye umeme kwanza.

scams.name: False Medical Emergency & Stranded Relative Mobile Money Scam
scams.name_en: False Medical Emergency & Acquaintance Impersonation Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: send money to this temporary number
do not call anyone else right now

scams.signals_en: Scammers call from an unfamiliar number or use a hijacked account to pose as a relative, colleague, or hospital staff member claiming a loved one had a sudden road accident or arrest.
scams.legit_en: Genuine hospitals and public authorities follow standard admission and family notification procedures without demanding instant mobile money transfers to private numbers.
bait_tactics: Hold on, the line has terrible static—which clinic reception desk did you say you're calling from?
Wait a minute, my mobile wallet balance is nearly zero right now and the nearest agent shop is closed.
Let me find a pen to write down the doctor's name first because my screen keeps freezing.
